newsitem.title: CHINA: Samsung Insurance opens office in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Insurance opens office in Shanghai.

text.p: South Korea's Samsung Fire and Marine Insurance Co opened a representative office in Shanghai on Thursday, the Xinhua news agency said.
The office is its second in China. It opened its first office in Beijing in 1995.

The opening of the new office showed Samsung's determination to explore the Chinese market and its confidence about its business in Shanghai, Xinhua quoted Jin-won You, chief representative of Samsung Shanghai, as saying.
China has so far allowed just four foreign insurers to open branches in China, but dozens more foreign firms have set up representative offices in hopes of winning a business licence.
